title: Integrating single-molecule spectroscopy and simulations for the study of intrinsically disordered proteins.
authors: Alston, Jhullian J; Soranno, Andrea; Holehouse, Alex S
one_liner_zh: 综述单分子荧光光谱与分子模拟结合研究无序蛋白构象行为的方法，虽聚焦IDP构象而非直接PPI机制，但方法整合思路对IDR互作建模有迁移启发。
abstract: Over the last two decades, intrinsically disordered proteins and protein regions (IDRs) have emerged from a niche corner of biophysics to be recognized as essential drivers of cellular function. Various techniques have provided fundamental insight into the function and dysfunction of IDRs. Among these techniques, single-molecule fluorescence spectroscopy and molecular simulations have played a major role in shaping our modern understanding of the sequence-encoded conformational behavior of disordered proteins. While both techniques are frequently used in isolation, when combined they offer synergistic and complementary information that can help uncover complex molecular details. Here we offer an overview of single-molecule fluorescence spectroscopy and molecular simulations in the context of studying disordered proteins. We discuss the various means in which simulations and single-molecule spectroscopy can be integrated, and consider a number of studies in which this integration has uncovered biological and biophysical mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 在过去的二十年里，固有无序蛋白质及蛋白质区域（IDRs）已从生物物理学的一个小众领域崛起，被公认为细胞功能的关键驱动因素。多种技术为理解IDRs的功能与功能障碍提供了基础性见解。在这些技术中，单分子荧光光谱学和分子模拟在塑造我们对无序蛋白质序列编码构象行为的现代理解方面发挥了重要作用。尽管这两种技术常被独立使用，但结合使用时，它们能提供协同且互补的信息，有助于揭示复杂的分子细节。在此，我们概述了单分子荧光光谱学和分子模拟在研究无序蛋白质中的应用。我们讨论了模拟与单分子光谱学整合的各种方式，并考察了若干通过这种整合揭示生物学和生物物理学机制的研究案例。
